record.notes: The record is the unified bill text that the National Assembly's Education, Culture, Science, Technology, Innovation and Ancestral Knowledge committee built from two initiatives filed in 2024: the Organic Law on the Regulation and Promotion of Artificial Intelligence in Ecuador (Assembly member Silvia Patricia Núñez Ramos, filed 20 June 2024, no. 450889) and the Law for the Promotion and Development of Artificial Intelligence (Karina del Carmen Subía Dávalos, filed 30 July 2024). The Legislative Administration Council authorised unification on 6 December 2024 and the committee reported the two bills unified on 16 December 2024; the unified text has no registry number of its own. The committee approved its report for first debate with seven votes on 31 August 2026, recommending archiving. On 15 September 2026 the Plenary approved the archiving motion in first debate with 88 votes in favour, 60 against and 1 abstention. The committee said the archiving does not abandon AI regulation but requires first strengthening the national strategy for the ethical and responsible development and use of AI and the institutional, technical and legal conditions for an updated framework.

verification.note: Stored from the National Assembly (asambleanacional.gob.ec and its repository): the press release of 15 Sep 2026 (Plenary archives the bill, 88 votes), the committee's report for first debate of 31 Aug 2026 (31 pages, recommending archiving), the Plenary's record (Acta 123-AN-2025-2029, 15 Sep 2026, 124 pages) with the motion and the vote count, the archive description of the Acta, and the Assembly's page for the Núñez initiative (filed 20 Jun 2024). The Acta and the committee report confirm the title, the 2024 origin, the unification of two initiatives, the dates, the recommendation and the vote. The bill's own unified text is not among the stored files; the description of its content rests on the committee report and the Assembly's press releases. The record follows the maintainers' decision on issue #150 (keep): it is the unified committee text archived on 15 Sep 2026, not a single filed initiative.
